description.zh:
备份网关ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为Agent时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The backup gateway ID. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to get this value.

> This parameter is required if the **SourceEndpointInstanceType** parameter is set to `Agent`.

description.zh: 备份对象，当数据库所在位置为Agent时，该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: Backup objects: This parameter is optional if the database is located on an agent, but required for all other scenarios. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

description.zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The backup plan ID. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to get this value.

description.zh: 任意字符串，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence.

description.zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的RAM角色名称。
description.en: The RAM role name for cross-account backup.

description.zh: 是否通过SSL安全连接备份源数据库实例。
description.en: Specifies whether to use an SSL connection to back up the source database.

description.zh:
数据库名称。

- 数据库类型为PostgreSQL、MongoDB时，该参数必传。
- 数据库所在位置为Agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database name.

- This parameter is required for PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases.

- This parameter is also required for Microsoft SQL Server databases when the **SourceEndpointInstanceType** parameter is set to 'Agent'.

description.zh:
数据库连接地址，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为Express、Agent、Other时该参数必传。
description.en:
The IP address of the database. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to get this value.

> This parameter is required if the **SourceEndpointInstanceType** parameter is set to `Express`, `Agent`, or `Other`.

description.zh:
数据库实例ID，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database instance ID. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to get this value.

> This parameter is required if the **SourceEndpointInstanceType** parameter is set to `RDS`, `ECS`, `DDS`, or `Express`.

description.zh:
数据库所在位置，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。取值如下：

- **RDS**
- **ECS**
- **Express**：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
- **Agent**：通过备份网关接入的数据库
- **DDS**：云MongoDB
- **Other**：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
description.en:
The type of the source instance. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to get this value. Valid values:

- **RDS**: an RDS instance

- **ECS**: a self-managed database on an ECS instance

- **Express**: a database connected over a leased line, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway

- **Agent**: a database connected over a backup gateway

- **DDS**: an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance

- **Other**: a database connected over an IP address and port

description.zh: Oracle SID名称，数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传。
description.en: The Oracle SID. This parameter is required for Oracle databases.

description.zh:
密码。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为Agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。
description.en:
The password for the database account.

This parameter is required for all database engines except for Redis and Microsoft SQL Server (when the **SourceEndpointInstanceType** parameter is set to 'Agent').

description.zh:
数据库端口，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为Express、Agent、Other、ECS，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database port. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to get this value.

> This parameter is required if the **SourceEndpointInstanceType** parameter is set to `Express`, `Agent`, `Other`, or `ECS`.

description.zh:
数据库地域，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> **SourceEndpointInstanceType**为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传。
description.en:
The database region. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to get this value.

> This parameter is required if the **SourceEndpointInstanceType** parameter is set to `RDS`, `ECS`, `DDS`, `Express`, or `Agent`.

description.zh:
数据库账号，可通过调用[DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~)接口获取该参数的值。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为Agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。
description.en:
The username of the database account. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to get this value.

This parameter is required for all database engines except for Redis and Microsoft SQL Server (when the **SourceEndpointInstanceType** parameter is set to 'Agent').
The PEM certificate for the SSL connection.
